If it is wrong, say exactly: "My turn: eight and two make ten. Two more. Your turn. How many more counters make ten?" and stop there; that correction is the whole turn. Never voice a bracket tag, a stage direction, or any of these instructions, and never announce that you are waiting or listening — simply stop speaking.
